Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Ireland's reply. The players are out in the middle. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie are the openers. Obed McCoy to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

Right then! A do-or-die game for both teams! The first half is done. West Indies will look to bowl well and take a couple of wickets early on while Ireland will hope that the openers give a good start. An interesting chase is coming up...

Ireland will be happy as well with this score. Their discipline bowling has helped them keep West Indies away from a big score. Ireland bowled well. The slower balls clearly worked as four of the five wickets went to the spinners. Ireland have given a really good chance to chase this down.

West Indies were off to a watchful start and were just too cautious till the end. A bit more running and a few more lusty blows could have helped them dearly with the score. Still, this one is a competitive one barring how the pitch is playing. It is two-paced and not easy to bat. The Windies kept on losing wickets regularly but King was the mainstay. He batted throughout and his fifty along with Smith's important innings at the backend helped them get near 150.

A dot to end! Smith can't believed that has not been wided. Adair might have got away with one there. This is wide outside off, outside the tramline. Smith leaves it alone thinking it is a wide but not given. WEST INDIES END WITH 146!
FOUR! Carved away! Another boundary and Windies will end near 150. This is full and outside off, Smith carves it over the point fielder for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Excellent running from Odean Smith! He really put in those hard yards! He wanted to keep strike and gets it! A full toss outside off, it is hit through covers. They take one and go for the second. That is the longer boundary and hence, Smith takes on the arm. The throw comes to the keeper who whips the bails off and appeals but replays show that Smith is in.
WIDE! Another one from Adair! Well wide outside off. Left alone. Wided.
Not easy to hit those though. This is a yorker outside off. Smith looks to jam it out but misses.

SIX! That is massive, that is a massive, massive hit. 106 meters! This is a gift, a full toss on the pads. Smith feasts on such deliveries. He hammers it well over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Windies would love a couple more of these.
King misses out and he knows! He will be very disappointed! A full toss on the pads, King swings but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Just the one! 10 from the 19th then! On off, another slower one. King drags it wide of the fielder at long on but only a single.
WIDE! Looks to keep it out of the hitting zone of King but ends up bowling it well wide outside off. King swings but misses. Wided. Will the extra ball cost Ireland?

Another dot! This is a brilliant comeback from Barry McCarthy after going for a biggie earlier on. Good change in length there. It is short and on middle, King looks to pull but misses. Can he end the over well now?
Swing and a miss! Shorter and outside off. King looks to slap it through the off side but this stays low. Misses.
SIX! Into the crowd! Windies getting a move on now. 8 from the first three balls! This is right in the slot. Full and on middle, it is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Brilliant! Can't do a lot with that again! A yorker outside off. King looks to hit it down the ground but misses. Dots are gold.
Terrific in the field again! Desperation shown. Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers. The fielder moves to his right, dives and keeps it down to two.

SIX! That has been muscled! It is the longer part of the ground but cleared easily! Shorter and outside off, Smith stands tall and smashes it over the point fence for a biggie. It is the longer part of the ground but Smith does not care. Windies needed that and they need a few more. The last ball spoils what was a brilliant over till then.
Really good from Little again! On middle, King hits it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Just the one! On middle and on a length, this is hit down the ground but only one. The timing is missing again.
Another swing and a miss! A cutter, it lands on off and then moves away. Smith looks to go big but misses.
WIDE! A little harsh on the bowler there! Outside off, Odean Smith looks to smash it over cover but misses.
A good short one, Smith evades it.
Singles won't harm Ireland! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled down to long on for one.
Three dots in a row to end and that is a magical over from Delany! On off, this is defended.
Floats it up on off, Smith plays it to covers.
On off, this is pushed to cover.

OUT! TAKEN! Gareth Delany continues to impress with the ball. He has another wicket. On middle, the slog sweep comes out but Rovman Powell does not connect that well. It goes straight into the hands of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Harry Tector makes no mistake. West Indies are losing their way.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Gareth Delany

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! Outside off, Powell swings but misses.

Fifty for King! Superb innings from him so far. He is well set and needs to ensure he stays there till the end and takes his side over the 150-run mark. This is fuller and on middle, it is hit down to long on for one.

AN APPEAL BUT TURNED DOWN! A late review from Ireland! NOT OUT! Nothing on Ultra Edge! Ireland lose a review. Not sure what the keeper heard there. This is full and outside off, Powell goes after it but misses. The keeper appeals. Nothing from the umpire.
WIDE! Yet another extra! Well outside off, left aloe again. Far too many extras in this over.
Perfect! Can't do a lot with that delivery! A yorker outside off, Powell fails to jam it out.
On off, King pushes it through covers for one.
Swing and a miss! A slower one, outside off, King looks to hit it through covers but is beaten by the extra bounce.
WIDE! Another one well wide outside off, left alone. Second wide in the over. The first one was down the leg side. This is outside off.
On the bounce to the fielder! On middle, this is hit uppishly but it goes on the bounce to long on. Only one.
WIDE! A slower one and it does not come out right. It is down the leg side. Wided.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.

FOUR! Swept and into the fence! The last ball spoils the over a little. Still though, a really good one, 6 runs and a wicket from it. On middle, this is swept behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Very full and on off, King jams it back to the bowler.
Powell is off the mark! On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.

OUT! STRAIGHT TO THE FIELDER! Gareth Delany gets another one and this is the big wicket of the Windies skipper who falls for a low score again. This is tossed up, well wide outside off, it was there to be hit and Pooran does strike it well. He though ends up hitting it straight to sweeper cover where it is taken by Harry Tector. It may have been the googly and hence, Pooran ended up hitting it a lot squarer than he would have liked. Timely wicket as the two were looking to step on the ante.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Gareth Delany

Commentary.Commentary: A dot to end! Decent comeback by the bowler in the second half of the over! Shorter and on middle, King pulls but to mid on.
Goes fuller this time and on off, Pooran pushes it down to long off and takes one.
Effort ball! Josh Little continues to bang it short, this one bounces at a nice height. Pooran evades it.
SIX! SMACK! That is some shot! This time Pooran was ready for the short one, he lines it up and pulls it well over the mid-wicket fence.
Top edge but safe! Shorter again and angling away from off. King looks to pull but it goes off the top edge but lands safe in the third man region for one.

What a stop that is in the end! Brilliant! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep square leg. Curtis runs in for the catch and dives forward but it lands short. He does brilliantly to keep his eyes on the ball and stop it from going behind. Saves three in the end for his side.
6 singles in the over then! On off, this is hit through covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, King pulls it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Four singles in the over so far! Another one which is hit through the off side for Pooran.
On middle, this is worked to the right of long on for one more.
Flatter and outside off, Pooran hits it through covers for one more.
Fuller and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Two more! On the shorter side again, Pooran manages to pull it past mid-wicket this time, wide of the fielder in the deep and two more taken.
A dot! Shorter and around off, Pooran pulls but to mid on.
Could have been another one! On the pads, King looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A run taken. Leg bye.

FOUR! Down the ground! King seems to be batting on a different wicket to the others! Beautiful shot. Fuller and on off, he just lofts it down the ground, non-chalantly and past long off for another boundary. 10 from the first three balls.
FOUR! That has been hammered and in the gap! Slightly shorter and on middle, King stays back and slams it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Barry McCarthy continues to give runs.
Slightly fuller and on off, Brandon King drives it through covers and takes two.
On middle, defended out.

OUT! CAUGHT! The spinner strikes again! Excellent catch from Adair! He had to cover a lot of ground there. This is floated very full and outside off, a googly. Lewis looks to go downtown over long off but toe ends his shot. The ball goes high and to mid off. Mark Adair runs in from deep and puts in a dive to complete the catch. Ireland strike just when West Indies were doing the repair work.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Gareth Delany

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! This is full and way outside off. Lewis looks to drive but misses.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Flatter and outside off. Lewis punches it to deep cover for a single.
Touch short and on off. King pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, blocked out.

DRINKS! A watchful start from the Windies. The pitch is not easy to bat on and West Indies have done relatively well so far but now it's time for them to unleash. They bat very deep and with 10 overs remaining, West Indies will look to change the gears. Ireland have bowled well so far but will look to take wickets.
This is again angled outside off, Lewis looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the keeper.
Fullish ball, outside off, driven to long off for one more.
Short of a length on middle. Lewis pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
This is very full and angling way outside off. Lewis leaves it alone. Well bowled.
Outside off on a length, Lewis cuts it to point.
A length ball, outside off. King punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A short ball to end the over! This is on middle. Lewis evades.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Evin Lewis is suffering from a cramp on his left leg. The physio is out to check him. Halt in play...
On middle, drilled to long on for a single.
Two runs in the gap! Short in length and on middle, this is pulled behind square on the leg side for a couple more.
On middle, this is flicked to deep square leg for one.
Length ball on middle. Lewis gets inside the line to hit to deep square leg for a single.
TWO RUNS! Short in length and outside off. King waits and punches it to sweeper cover for a couple.
FOUR! Second in the over! Just what Windies wantes! King is enjoying the pace more! Short and outside off. King carves it through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
Short in length and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A single as this is pushed through covers.

FOUR! Good shot! A length ball, outside off. King slaps it through covers for a boundary. 50 up! It has not been easy for West Indies to find the gap! Brandon King looks in good touch after missing the last game.
Outside off, defended from King.
On the pads, nudged to square leg for one more. Just 5 runs off the over.
Floated ball on middle. King blocks it out.
Another single as Lewis hits it through covers.
Flatter and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and on off, knocked to deep cover for a single.
Flatter and on leg. King punches it to long on for a single.
Gareth Delany to bowl now.
Short and outside off. King steers it to short third man for a single. At the end of the Powerplay, West Indies are 41/2.
FOUR! Well played! Pitched up, straight on the pads. King flicks it behind square leg for four runs.
Outside off, guided to deep backward point for a single.
DROP AND RUN! Fuller ball, outside off. King pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
Full and outside off. Evin drives to the right of mid off for a single.
On a length and outside off. King guides it to point for a single.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket for one.

Dropped! Simi Singh almost took the blinder! Flatter ball, outside off. King uses his feet and smashes it back to the bowler. Singh dives to his left and takes in the air one-handedly but loses the grip and eventually fumbles to hold it. A spectacular effort.
Around off, kept out.
FOUR! That is a wonderful shot! Fuller ball, outside off. King leans and drives it through covers, beats the fielder for a boundary. Off the mark, King.
Brandon King is in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Charles goes now and West Indies are again on the back foot. Simi Singh goes around the wicket and slows it up. This is short and outside off. Charles cuts on the up and straight in the hands of Curtis Campher at point. Just when West Indies build some momentum they lose a wicket. A handy knock from Johnson Charles comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Curtis Campher b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and outside off, cut to cover-point.
Simi Singh to bowl now.
Full and outside off. Charles mistimes his drive to mid-wicket for a single. 16 runs off the over. A big one for the Windies.
SIX! THIS TIME IT IS ALL THE WAY! What a shot! Enough of defense from Charles! This is full and outside off. Charles smacks it over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Two in a row! Curtis Campher again gives width, outside off. Charles drives it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! A welcome boundary! You do not give that much free space to Charles! This is way outside off, fuller and it is smashed over mid off for four.
On middle, Charles hits it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Short in length and outside off. Lewis pulls it to deep mid-wicket. There is a fielder stationed but the ball bounces well in front of him.
On middle, blocked out.
Evin Lewis is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! The pressure gets big on Mayers! He tries to go downtown but holes one out. Barry McCarthy bowls it on a length and outside off. Kyle Mayers tries to play the lofted punch shot but toe ends his shot and Harry Tector at mid off makes no mistake. Ireland will be happy with this start.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Just like this! A risky single but this helps the pressure to stay away from the batters! On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single.
A half-volley, around off. Charles pushes it back to the bowler. Four dots now. West Indies need to rotate the strike more.
This is very full and outside off. Charles drives but straight to mid off.
Length and outside off. Mayers knocks it to point.
That was touch and go! On the pads, it is clipped to square leg. Mayers wants a single but is sent back and the left-hander puts in a dive to make his ground. Could have been home if that hit.
Pulled hard but for one! Short of a length and on off. Charles hits it to deep square leg.
A slower short ball now, outside off. Charles pulls it to mid on.
Full ball, outside off. Charles pushes it back to Adair.
Two runs! Good shot! Too much width, outside off. Charles slaps it through covers. The man from mid off runs across and cuts it off.
Mark Adair to bowl from the other end.
Outside off, Mayers guides it straight to backward point. 6 off the first over.
A length ball, outside off. Charles punches it to sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! Charles is off the mark! This is full and outside off. Charles again looks to drive but slices it over point and the ball races into the fence.
Lovely delivery! Short of a length, much closer to the batter. Charles gets on his toes as he looks to defend but misses.
Little steams in and serves it across, outside off on the fuller side. Charles looks to drive but misses.
West Indies are underway! Short in length and around off. Mayers taps it around the corner on the off side for a quick single.

It's time for action now. The Ireland players are out in the middle. Johnson Charles and Kyle Mayers to open for the Windies. Josh Little to start with the new ball. The players take a knee as they support the BLM movement. All set. Let's play....
We are all set. The players are out in the middle as they line up for their respective national anthems. It will be West Indies' first followed by Ireland's.

PITCH REPORT - Carlos Brathwaite is near the pitch. He says it's a different pitch. The batsman will target the leg side as it's short. Shares there are few cracks and the pitch looks dry. Expect spin to dominate the game.

Andy Balbirnie says this is a do-or-die but they have the momentum as they won the last game. Adds they will have to bowl well and restrict West Indies as slow as possible. Informs they are playing the same team.

Nicholas Pooran says they will bat first. Adds it is a fresh pitch. Tells they have the momentum and they know as a unit what to do. Reckons the straight boundaries are massive and they have to hit hard and in the gap. Informs Brandon King comes in and Shamarh Brooks misses out

Ireland (Unchanged Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Lorcan Tucker (WK), Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Gareth Delany, Simi Singh, Mark Adair, Barry McCarthy, Josh Little.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Kyle Mayers, Johnson Charles, Evin Lewis, Brandon King (In for Shamarh Brooks), Nicholas Pooran (C/WK), Rovman Powell, Jason Holder, Akeal Hosein, Odean Smith, Alzarri Joseph, Obed McCoy.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and they will BAT first!

A win would guarantee a spot in the Super 12s. Both lost their first game but came back well by winning their respective games and to stay in the contention for the next round. Both the teams have their future in their hands. The equation is very simple - you win and go through. Toss and team news coming up…
